subject: general
question:
Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

In many places, restoring mangrove forests can be an extreme effective strategy.
solution:
The correct option is "option 4".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• The error lies in option 4 of the sentence.
 
• Here, we can use "**extremely**" in place of "**extreme"** to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• In the given sentence, "extreme" is an **adjective **and we have to use the adverb "extremely" in place of the adjective "extreme" to modify the **adjective "effective".**
 
• So, we replace the adjective "extreme" with the adverb "extremely" to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• All the other options are correct.

 

Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.

Correct sentence__: *In many places, restoring mangrove forests can be an **__extremely__ **effective strategy.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__ **

__
 
• Adverb: It adds more information about a place, time, manner, cause, or degree to a verb, an adjective, a phrase, or another adverb__*.*​​​​​​

 
 
• Example: *Speaks arrogantly, very deeply.*
